ready.description: True only if a fixer given exactly this finding and this code can make the fix and a test that fails without it.

bug_visible.description: The code shown demonstrates the reported problem (not just mentions it).

context_missing.description: Code a fixer needs but wasn't shown, as path:Class.member (members, constants and variables too). Empty if nothing.

test_file_ok.description: The test file can host a test for this: right level (a unit test for pure logic; an integration or end-to-end test when the setup needs more) and the setup it needs exists there.

better_test_file.description: A better existing test file path from the list, or empty.

fix_sound.description: The suggested fix would solve the problem without breaking intended behaviour, and can be tested the way that test file feeds input.

problems.description: Each concrete problem with the finding as a fix task, one short sentence each.
